'''Boulders''' are oversized rocks, occupying 4 tiles, found on [[The Farm]], in [[The Mines]], [[Skull Cavern]] and [[Quarry Mine]]. They are one of the main sources of [[Stone|stone]] in the game. However, no [[Mining]] Experience points are gained by destroying boulders.

==Boulders on the Farm==
Multiple boulders are present on the farm at the start of the game, frequently blocking access to bridges or other features.  Removing them requires an upgraded [[Pickaxes|Pickaxe]], steel quality or higher, yielding 15 [[Stone]]s.

The original farm boulders will never reappear once removed.  However, rare [[Random Events#Meteorite|meteorites]] may occasionally crash into the farm.

==Boulders in the Mines==
Boulders in the mine can be broken using any quality [[Pickaxes|Pickaxe]], yielding 10 [[Stone]]s.
